_comment: Transcribed from in-game screens captured 2026-08-05 (Steam captures 20260805170411 NATO art, 170414 Pax Armata art, 170359 Sniper, 170400 Spec Ops). The class active ability is recorded once on the class rather than on each training path because both path screens show the same LVL 03 entry.
name: Recon
_alias_note: No bare "recon" alias. It would tag every Recon Drone line, and the Wraith Recon skin, to the class page.

description.text: The perfect intelligence and counterintelligence operative. Neutralize targets from a distance, or infiltrate, gathering intel and disrupting hostile forces.

ability.name: UAV Overwatch
ability.description: Call in a UAV to shadow you in a 100m radius and spot enemy combatants for 60s.

training_paths.name: Sniper
training_paths.description: Specialists in long-range engagements. Spot enemies more efficiently and target threats with lethal headshots.

abilities.name: Confirmed Kill
abilities.description: Enemy soldiers you kill with headshots from a sniper rifle cannot be revived by their teammates.

abilities.name: Target Acquired
abilities.description: Inflicting damage on enemies spots them, marking their position in-world and on the minimap.

abilities.name: Enhanced Perception
abilities.description: Improved Auto-Spotting range with 33% increased distance and 10% wider angle of detection from weapon crosshair. Spotting is quicker and lasts 3s longer.

training_paths.name: Spec Ops
training_paths.description: Masters of infiltration and sabotage. Operate with stealth to remain undetected for longer and silently neutralize enemy targets.

abilities.name: Low Profile
abilities.description: Going prone clears your in-combat state 1.5s faster and reduces your spotted status duration by 33%.

abilities.name: Gadget Awareness
abilities.description: Spot nearby enemy gadgets, marking their position in-world and on the minimap. Ability inactive while sprinting.

abilities.name: Stealth Tactics
abilities.description: Reduces sounds you make when crouched or prone. Also applies when performing takedowns on an enemy.

_tag_deny_note: The XFGM-6D Recon Drone has its own page and accounts for most uses of the word. Wraith Recon is a skin. "Recon device" is EA's phrasing for the HTI-Mk2 gadget.
